implementation_summary: export-api.ts builds the download links for the Audit Documents, the Pitch Glimpse and the Owner Audit with auditPath(AUDIT_API.export|pitch|owner.path) and URLSearchParams. The documents query is always an explicit comma-separated list in AUDIT_DOCUMENT_KINDS order, all five when none is unticked. exportUrl returns null when no document is ticked. ExportDocumentsScreen.tsx has a stateless ExportDocumentsView with checkboxes for the five Audit Documents, language radios (en/ta), format radios (md, html, pdf, docx, bundle), and separate Pitch Glimpse (html/pdf, en/ta) and Owner Audit (md/html/pdf/docx, en/ta) groups. All three downloads are <a download> GET links. There is no form and no send, email, share or message control. settings-api.ts provides loadSettings (GET /api/audit-settings) and saveSettings (PUT JSON), maps errors to plain sentences, and has draftFrom, settingsUpdate (only the changed fields), resetProposalTemplate ({proposalTemplate:null}), resetOptOutText(lang) and a copy of the core PROPOSAL_PLACEHOLDERS list. DocumentSettingsScreen.tsx has a stateless DocumentSettingsView with the Proposal template textarea, a put-the-default-back control and the placeholder list; English and Tamil opt-out textareas, each showing its default with its own put-the-default-back control and the sentence that the tool user owns checking the text; and six company detail fields. The DocumentSettingsScreen wrapper handles loading, error, save and reset states. All @qa/types imports go through '@qa/types/src/browser.js'. Styling reuses the existing classes and components.
